title: One-off liaison inventory & effort sampler — Jan 2027
body:
Purpose: quick single-view inventory of ad-hoc cross-functional asks and a light estimate for owner planning. Not comprehensive; intended for 1x sync and to hand off small one-off items to liaisons.

Scope: items surfaced during last 2 weeks of support scrubs + ops triage channel. Includes headcount/owner suggestions, rough effort (hours) and a recommended next action. Use this sheet to roster short-term owners for the upcoming 10-day window.

Method: I collected items from Slack thread (#ops-handoff), two triage calls (01/05 and 01/06), and quick checks against INF-7421. Estimates are intentionally conservative.

Table (columns: Item | Suggested owner | Priority | Est hours | Target date | Current blocker | Next action)

1) Fallback-route quick-check | Ethan Ruiz | H | 6 | 2027-01-10 | missing region mapping for eu-west-2 | Run smoke in eu-west-2, update routing table, escalate to platform if missing keys
2) Weekend manual-coverage roster (Jan 15-16) | Priya Khatri | H | 4 | 2027-01-13 | no confirmed standby volunteers | Post ask in #oncall, call out platform and docs for coverage pair
3) Partner SLA escalation (Acct: LumenEdge) | Noah Park | H | 8 | 2027-01-12 | awaiting partner logs (SFTP delivery) | Pull logs, open temporary incident bridge with partner SE, attach to OPS-3180
4) Billing credits reconciliation (one-off) | Maya Chen | M | 3 | 2027-01-14 | partial export from billing system | Export CSV, reconcile against invoices, raise credits if mismatch > $250
5) Regional capacity pledge contact refresh (APAC) | Ethan Ruiz | M | 5 | 2027-01-18 | outdated contact list | Ping named contacts, update spreadsheet, flag any offline regions
6) Lightweight smoke tests for new batching knob | Priya Khatri | H | 10 | 2027-01-16 | need test corpus + staging capacity | Create 50-request corpus, reserve staging slots, run 3 waves and capture latency histogram
7) Small doc handoff: rollout checklist for canary route | Maya Chen | L | 2 | 2027-01-11 | draft missing SRE reviewer | Add SRE reviewer (noah), small pass and publish to Confluence pageId 842910
8) Quick KV-cache health scan for top 10 routes | Noah Park | M | 6 | 2027-01-15 | partial telemetry gaps | Run kv-cache sanity script, collect gaps, file follow ups for missing traces
9) One-off quant pilot triage (customer trial) | Ethan Ruiz | M | 12 | 2027-01-20 | unclear perf target for trial | Sync with applied-ml, set perf target, scope pilot steps, link to GH PR 2294
10) Small security checklist for private deploy demo | Priya Khatri | H | 4 | 2027-01-13 | awaiting customer KMS details | Request KMS tenancy info, validate HSM compatibility, add to demo checklist

Notes: 
- If owner unavailable, tag "backup:" followed by team (e.g., backup: eng-sre).
- Est hours assume contiguous chunking; if spread over multiple days, increase by 20% slack.
- I prioritized items that unblock customer-facing or high-risk ops flows.

Quick rollup (for 10-day window):
- Total estimated hours: 60 (approx)
- High priority items: 5 (estimated 32 hours)
- Suggested immediate asks: post roster and confirm volunteers by 2027-01-09 EOD

Open questions / followups:
- Can SRE spare 4 hours on 01/11 to review the canary checklist? (noah)
- Who owns partner log ingestion (SFTP) long-term? If infra, please link owner.
- Is there a preferred canonical sheet for billing credits? If not, I will keep this one as temporary.

Notes to self (Maya):
- After owners confirmed, create jira tickets for items with >6h and assign.
- Move all small items (<4h) to a shared "ops quick hits" board for sprint-planning.

Audit trail: 01/07 created initial rows; 01/09 added partner SLA detail after call with Noah; 01/11 published to #ops-handoff for volunteer asks; 01/15 minor edits and estimates adjusted after sync with Priya.

Last updated by: Maya Chen (mchen@redwood.example)
